mapper.select: SELECT acct_no AS account_id, -- 계좌번호 cust_no AS customer_id, -- 고객번호 -- 계좌구분. 1=CHECKING, 2=SAVINGS, 나머지 UNKNOWN CASE upper(btrim(acct_dv_cd)) WHEN '1' THEN 'CHECKING' WHEN '2' THEN 'SAVINGS' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS account_type, to_char(bal_amt, 'FM9999999990.00') AS balance, -- 잔액. 소수 둘째 자리 문자열 -- 개설시각. 시간대가 없는 값을 한국 시각으로 보고 +09:00을 붙인다 CASE WHEN open_dt IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_char(open_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || '+09:00' END AS opened_at, COALESCE(upper(btrim(use_yn)) = 'Y', FALSE) AS active, -- use_yn이 Y일 때만 true 'LEGACY_ACCT' AS source_system, 'ACCOUNT_SNAPSHOT' AS event_type, to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || '+09:00' AS extracted_at FROM src_acct ORDER BY acct_no
